answers.description: One answer per field, keyed by field name. value is null when the input does not determine it. Generated answers (text, number, boolean, enum, object, source_only fields, lists) carry valid/complete/decoder metadata; typed answers (date, time, datetime, duration, compute) carry guess instead.

guess.description: Typed answers only: the best non-null candidate, returned even when value is null.

valid.description: Generated answers: whether the output satisfied the field's schema. value is null when false.

complete.description: Generated answers: whether generation terminated normally.

decoder.description: Generated answers: decoder that produced the value, e.g. parallel-ar-json-scalar-v1 or native_source_scalar_v1.

tokens.description: Generated answers: completion tokens, including retries.

raw.description: Generated answers: the raw generated JSON.

confidence.description: Generated answers: probability of the returned value (including a null value); 0 when invalid. Typed answers: probability of guess.

log_probability.description: Generated answers: log probability of the generated sequence. Present only when valid.

span.description: [start, end] character offsets into state, or null when the value has no unique match in the input.

spans.description: Lists: one span or null per item.

property_spans.description: Object lists read from tables: per row, a map of property name to span or null.

printed_value.description: source_only fields: the text as printed in the input.

failure_reason.description: Why an answer is invalid, e.g. not_in_source.

retry_input_tokens.description: Input tokens spent on retries for this field.

steps.description: Forecast only: one estimate per step.

truncated.description: True when any generated answer or list is invalid or incomplete. Input is never truncated.
